mechanism: Capture the fixed-shape cache-indexed routed-plus-shared expert wave once as a compute indirect command buffer, retain one persistent scalar-parameter arena and all directly or indirectly referenced resources, then replay it inside the existing router TokenCommandBuffer.

scope.wait_count_claim: UNCHANGED: replay replaces host encoding and direct encoder count inside the existing expert-wave command buffer; it does not remove a submit/wait.

persistent_replay_contract.capture_key: lease generation, routed/shared dispatch modes, dimensions, expert count, and exact GPU addresses of tables, indirect weights, activations, selections, weights, miss mask, scratch, and residual
persistent_replay_contract.pipeline_cache: Separate context-level cache compiled with supportIndirectCommandBuffers=true.
persistent_replay_contract.indirect_weight_residency: Every table-referenced PQ/native buffer is retained by its immutable lease and declared read-only on the direct replay encoder.
persistent_replay_contract.ordering: Every dependent ICB stage has an explicit barrier; execution matches the qualified sequential expert order.
persistent_replay_contract.profiler: Logical dispatch counts and semantic GPU-stage accounting remain exact; aggregate CPU-encode tracing uses replayable_compute_graph rather than an unexplained bucket.

flagship_source_projection.kind: source-derived command count only; no sealed execution or latency claim

fail_closed_evidence.split_or_per_dispatch_gpu_trace_mode: Rejected because commands inside the ICB cannot be attributed honestly.
fail_closed_evidence.missing_routed_triplet: Validation writes the miss mask; every later scratch/residual write returns without mutation; qualified host-known wave remains the fallback.
fail_closed_evidence.unsupported_heterogeneous_member: Validation rejects the triplet before paired PQ/native projection commands can write.
fail_closed_evidence.scratch_growth_or_route_refresh: GPU address/generation key mismatch rebuilds the graph instead of replaying stale bindings.

qualified: Warm cache-indexed R4, R0, native-BF16, and heterogeneous expert waves can use a persistent real Metal ICB without changing complete-token decisions or waits.
The graph cache remains valid across token-to-token selection content changes while failing closed on any buffer-address, lease-generation, mode, or geometry change.
The ICB path removes per-wave pipeline lookup and per-command host binding/encoding after capture while preserving exact logical dispatch accounting.
not_qualified: This is one fixed-shape expert subgraph, not a single replayable whole-token graph or a persistent GPU causal loop.
No latency/TPS improvement is claimed; repository measurements still classify ICB as below the performance ship gate.
No sealed Math-Preserve token, sustained 2K/8K/32K run, TTFT, memory-pressure, swap, or thermal promotion was performed.
Dynamic sequence-length attention is not captured; doing so with a 32K over-dispatch would be invalid without a measured kernel-level admission.
qualification.next_boundary: Keep the expert replay graph default-off; enumerate stable-buffer scalar ABIs for the remaining fixed-shape norm/router/head stages, while leaving sequence-length-dependent attention direct until a bounded dynamic-dispatch design is proven.
